description: I am an AI & ML engineering student passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, technology, and innovation. I enjoy learning new technologies, solving problems, and working on creative ideas. Our team aims to collaborate, share knowledge, and develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges. We are looking for enthusiastic teammates with skills in coding, AI/ML, data analysis, research, design, and problem-solving who are ready to learn and contribute.
summary: Our project, AI Butterfly, explores the integration of Artificial Intelligence, simulation, and wireless power transfer. The system uses a simulated butterfly model connected to an AI chip to process signals and control its operations. A transmitter and receiver system transfers energy wirelessly through electromagnetic coils to support the battery and motor unit. The main goal is to explore how intelligent control and wireless energy technologies can work together in an efficient system. This project demonstrates the potential of combining AI, automation, and energy-efficient technology to develop innovative solutions. It encourages further research into smart systems and sustainable technological applications.
